text.en:
There shall be created in each Executed Department whose annual budget exceeds P200 million,
the position of Assistant Secretary for Finance and Management which shall provide the Secretary Advice and
Assistance on financial, budgetary, accounting, and management matters pertaining to the Department and the
bureaus and agencies under it; shall supervise the coordinated preparation and implementation of annual and
long-term financial and work plans and budget estimates of these offices; shall conduct periodic
department-wide performance financial review; shall design and implement, subject to approval and in
coordination with other offices concerned, improvements in financial management systems, procedures and
practices and shall coordinate with the Budget Commission, Department of Finance, Commission on Audit
and other agencies in ensuring the government resources are effectively and efficiently used.

In each Executive Department whose annual budget exceeds P200 million and where there are
two or more Undersecretaries, the Secretary may assign these financial management duties to one of the
Undersecretaries or in his discretion appoint an Assistant Secretary of Finance and Management as provided
in this Decree. In case where the incumbent of the position Chief, Financial and Management Service is
appointed Assistant Secretary for Finance and Management, the Position Chief, Financial and Management
Service shall be abolished automatically.

Except for those which are attached or otherwise administered or supervised by a department,
government-owned or controlled corporations may create a position similar in function and rank to the
Assistant Secretary for Finance and Management, if such is considered necessary by them.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
